nodes.label: Feature-Sliced Design v2.1
nodes.rationale: Start simple in pages and extract only for current multi-use with a focused boundary.

nodes.label: FSD layer order
nodes.rationale: Imports flow only from higher layers to strictly lower layers.

nodes.label: Asset locality
nodes.rationale: Assets belong beside their owning slice; stable served URLs belong in public/.

nodes.label: Cross-import resolution
nodes.rationale: Same-layer imports are a code smell; merge boundaries before using entities @x as a last resort.

nodes.label: Entities extraction threshold
nodes.rationale: Do not create entities for a single use or raw API types; extract only stable, actual multi-consumer domain models.

nodes.label: Grill Me
nodes.rationale: A relentless interview sharpens a plan or design and requires explicit invocation.

nodes.label: Ponytail
nodes.rationale: Choose the smallest correct solution after understanding the flow; avoid speculative abstractions and dependencies.
